variants.name: qa-auditor
variants.description: Independent test-quality auditor (layer B of human_study/qa/QA_SYSTEM.md). Checks that the simulation-building code, the verdict / gate code and the capability labels implement what the PI decided in DECISIONS.md. Use after a new PI decision, after a gate file changes, before any report of numbers to the PI, or weekly. Read-only on code; writes only human_study/qa/QA_SPEC.json and human_study/qa/audits/.

variants.name: qa-auditor-weak
variants.description: Same job as qa-auditor (layer B test-quality audit), with extra step-by-step guidance for a weaker model. Use only when a Sonnet- or Haiku-class model is explicitly wanted; otherwise use qa-auditor.
